title: A project's pin: .gragas/pin.yaml, the file in which a repository names its rulebook (pin format 1)
description: Four keys and no other: the spec's version, kinds and content hash are not read by release 1. internal/core/project reads the pin in Go and holds it to the same rules, with the file and line of each refusal

source.description: the folder of the repository that holds the rulebook, relative to the folder holding .gragas/: slash-separated, no leading or trailing slash, no empty, . or .. step, no colon; . alone is that folder. A git host or a mirror is not read in release 1

parts.description: the parts in play for the project, at least one

format.description: the pin file's own version, not the rulebook's format
